name: es20-state-queries-errors
title: State queries, conversions and GL errors
summary: Initial values of ~70 ES 3.0 state-table entries read through all four Get commands and glIsEnabled, the 6.1.2 conversion rules (rounding vs the linear color/depth mapping, boolean/int/float, 64->32-bit saturation), indexed UBO/TF binding queries, hints, DITHER, and the 2.5 error model including INVALID_FRAMEBUFFER_OPERATION, shown as a pass/fail dashboard.
spec: ES 3.0 §2.1.6.2 Conversion from Floating-Point to Normalized Fixed-Point (Equation 2.4, used by Table 4.5 INT)
ES 3.0 §2.10.1.1 Binding Buffer Objects to Indexed Targets
ES 3.0 §2.10.3 Mapping and Unmapping Buffer Data
ES 3.0 §4.2.1 Selecting Buffers for Writing, §4.3.1 Selecting a Buffer for Reading
ES 3.0 §4.4.4.1 Framebuffer Attachment Completeness, §4.4.4.4 Effects of Framebuffer Completeness on Framebuffer Operations
ES 3.0 §6.1.1 Simple Queries, §6.1.2 Data Conversions, §6.1.6 String Queries, §6.1.9 Buffer Object Queries

api.glGetError: NO_ERROR when clean; error flag survives later valid commands until read; first error kept when three different errors occur; flags cleared after NO_ERROR
api.glGetBooleanv: every table entry: FALSE iff the value is zero (incl. 0.25 float state -> TRUE, zero mask -> FALSE)
api.glGetIntegerv: every table entry; floats rounded (0.25 -> 0, -2.75 -> -3, 0.75 -> 1); colors, DEPTH_RANGE and DEPTH_CLEAR_VALUE mapped to one of the two integers nearest f*(2^31-1); 64-bit values saturate to 2^31-1
api.glGetInteger64v: every table entry, same conversions as GetIntegerv; MAX_ELEMENT_INDEX >= 2^24-1
api.glGetFloatv: every table entry; booleans 1.0/0.0, integers and enum tokens coerced exactly, a negative clear color stored unclamped
api.glIsEnabled: initial value of 11 capabilities; DITHER after glDisable/glEnable
api.glGetIntegeri_v: UNIFORM_BUFFER_BINDING / TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER_BINDING per index (initial 0, after BindBufferRange/Base, after unbinding); out-of-range index -> INVALID_VALUE with the output untouched; DEPTH_FUNC -> INVALID_ENUM
api.glGetInteger64i_v: *_START / *_SIZE per index (range values, 0 after BindBufferBase); out-of-range index -> INVALID_VALUE with the output untouched; LINE_WIDTH -> INVALID_ENUM
api.glGetStringi: EXTENSIONS 0..NUM_EXTENSIONS-1 are exactly the GetString(EXTENSIONS) tokens; index NUM_EXTENSIONS -> INVALID_VALUE + NULL; RENDERER -> INVALID_ENUM + NULL
api.glGetString: EXTENSIONS token list compared with glGetStringi
api.glHint: GENERATE_MIPMAP_HINT and FRAGMENT_SHADER_DERIVATIVE_HINT: initial DONT_CARE, FASTEST/NICEST/DONT_CARE read back
api.glEnable: DITHER re-enabled (IsEnabled/Get*); RASTERIZER_DISCARD does not suppress INVALID_FRAMEBUFFER_OPERATION
api.glDisable: DITHER disabled: state reads FALSE and a non-representable clear is position-independent
api.glSampleCoverage: (0.75, TRUE): value rounds to 1 (not linearly mapped), invert reads 1
api.glClearColor: (1,0.5,0.25,0) and (-0.5,0.75,0,1) read back exactly as floats and linearly mapped as integers; a non-representable color clears to one of the two representable neighbours
api.glPixelStorei: UNPACK_ALIGNMENT 8 read back; 3 and PACK_SKIP_ROWS -1 -> INVALID_VALUE with the state unchanged
api.glStencilFunc: ref 5 / mask 0 read back (mask 0 -> GetBooleanv FALSE)
api.glScissor: negative height -> INVALID_VALUE, SCISSOR_BOX unchanged; per-cell rectangles of the dashboard verified by readback
api.glBindTexture: 2D texture on TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP -> INVALID_OPERATION, both bindings unchanged
api.glBindVertexArray: deleted name -> INVALID_OPERATION, previous VERTEX_ARRAY_BINDING kept
api.glBindBufferBase: indexed + generic binding set, START/SIZE read 0; ARRAY_BUFFER target -> INVALID_ENUM with ARRAY_BUFFER_BINDING unchanged
api.glBindBufferRange: BINDING/START/SIZE read back; index >= MAX_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BINDINGS, size 0, misaligned UBO offset, TF offset/size not multiple of 4 -> INVALID_VALUE with every binding unchanged
api.glMapBufferRange: offset+length > BUFFER_SIZE -> INVALID_VALUE, returns NULL, BUFFER_MAPPED stays FALSE
api.glUnmapBuffer: unmapped buffer -> INVALID_OPERATION; return value FALSE checked (XFAIL on radeonsi: Mesa glthread returns TRUE)
api.glCheckFramebufferStatus: INCOMPLETE_MISSING_ATTACHMENT (no attachments), INCOMPLETE_ATTACHMENT (RGBA8 on DEPTH_ATTACHMENT), COMPLETE before/after
api.glFramebufferRenderbuffer: attaching/detaching the depth image toggles completeness
api.glRenderbufferStorage: RGBA8 images for the dither and completeness experiments
api.glClear: incomplete FBO -> INVALID_FRAMEBUFFER_OPERATION (also with RASTERIZER_DISCARD) and the color image keeps its earlier contents; dashboard cells
api.glReadPixels: incomplete FBO -> INVALID_FRAMEBUFFER_OPERATION, client memory untouched; dither and dashboard readback

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi capture (and 800x800, 333x777): 12x12 grid of 139 green cells filling the surface; frames blue (initial state, 6 rows), violet (minimums), cyan (conversions), orange (indexed), grey (hints), olive (dither), pink (errors), khaki (framebuffer); one amber cell in the pink group = glUnmapBuffer return value (radeonsi glthread XFAIL); trailing unused cells dark. No seams or gaps.
